title: msm
description: MSM (Multimodal Surface Matching) is a tool for aligning brain surface scans based on their cortical folding patterns or functional/structural data

inmesh.description: Input mesh (available formats: VTK, ASCII, GIFTI). Needs to be a sphere
inmesh.title: Input mesh

refmesh.description: Reference mesh (available formats: VTK, ASCII, GIFTI). Needs to be a sphere. If not included algorithm assumes reference mesh is equivalent input
refmesh.title: Reference mesh

indata.description: Scalar or multivariate data for input - can be ASCII (.asc,.dpv,.txt) or GIFTI (.func.gii or .shape.gii)
indata.title: Input data

refdata.description: Scalar or multivariate data for reference - can be ASCII (.asc,.dpv,.txt) or GIFTI (.func.gii or .shape.gii)
refdata.title: Reference data

trans.description: Transformed source mesh (output of a previous registration). Use this to initialise the current registration.
trans.title: Transformed source mesh

in_register.description: Input mesh at data resolution. Used to resample data onto input mesh if data is supplied at a different resolution. Note this mesh HAS to be in alignment with either the input_mesh of (if supplied) the transformed source mesh. Use with supreme caution.
in_register.title: Input mesh at data resolution

inweight.description: Cost function weighting for input - weights data in these vertices when calculating similarity (ASCII or GIFTI). Can be multivariate provided dimension equals that of data
inweight.title: Input cost function weighting

refweight.description: Cost function weighting for reference - weights data in these vertices when calculating similarity (ASCII or GIFTI). Can be multivariate provided dimension equals that of data
refweight.title: Reference cost function weighting

format.description: Format of output files, can be: GIFTI, VTK, ASCII or ASCII_MAT (for full details of output file formats see MSM wiki)
format.title: Output format

levels.description: Number of resolution levels (default = number of resolution levels specified by --opt in config file)
levels.title: Resolution levels

smoothout.description: Smooth transformed output with this sigma (default=0)
smoothout.title: Output smoothing
